name: jedi-site-mapper-before-proxy
description: A task-buffer child builds JediTaskBuffer with one database proxy. prepareTasksToBeFinished_JEDI and setScoutJobDataToTasks_JEDI took that proxy and then called get_site_mapper(); when the child's mapper was missing or more than ten minutes old, SiteMapper's load_resource_types() waited for the proxy its caller held until the caller's 600 s timeout killed the child: 14 to 23 PostProcessor stalls a day since 2026-11-03 (stack capture 2026-11-11). Both methods now get the site mapper before taking the proxy. Branch wenaus/panda-server jedi-site-mapper-before-proxy.
